test_title: PYST 38: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option (1): FKOR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfcc536b66925f6e4e0ebf831404ff3ddbd227c313d9675a95717e6d8ca0d7ec.png] 

Option (2): BGKN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8e05d22893a0f9631c94218e6391fc48a42e6e2a9ae46927ff421f23554a379.png] 

Option (3): SXBE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2472781859cdef87b5211eb5629334a976e508f245846a97d3f1a428678785e.png] 

**Option (4): FYUB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cc51cc9c9c3c343773f63381b741b8ff5b0b970d0f7dd3ca3d75d814e2a83df.png] 

The letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to the group is: **FYUB.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (4)"**
